The Best Snooker Experience in Town

Snooker Zone is built for players who love the game. From beginners learning their first break to serious players practising for tournaments, our club gives everyone a clean, comfortable place to play.

Our tables are kept in top condition with fresh cloth, quality balls and bright, even lighting over every table.

  • Full-size tables
  • Fresh cloth
  • Air-conditioned hall
  • Quality cues
  • Cold drinks and snacks
  • Friendly staff
